experiment.title: FNSPID development reversal-confound test
experiment.objective: Test whether the development-period negative-story-share coefficient survives controls for the firm's own recent price path.

timing_and_controls.outcome: stock-minus-SPY adjusted-open return from t to t+1
timing_and_controls.lagged_return_1: stock adjusted-open return from t-1 to t
timing_and_controls.lagged_return_5: stock cumulative adjusted-open return from t-5 to t
timing_and_controls.sigma20: sample standard deviation of the 20 stock adjusted-open returns ending at t, requiring all 20 observations
timing_and_controls.no_outcome_overlap: Every price control ends at the formation open t; the outcome starts at that open.
timing_and_controls.cross_sectional_transform: Each price control is converted to an average-tie centred percentile rank within formation session, matching all other regressors.

estimand.unit: daily cross-sectional coefficient followed by a time-series mean
estimand.outcome: within-session average-tie percentile rank of ar_open_h1, centred at zero
base_regressors: within-session centred percentile rank of mean_continuous
within-session centred percentile rank of negative_share
within-session centred percentile rank of log(1 + n)
full_price_controls: within-session centred percentile rank of lagged_return_1
within-session centred percentile rank of lagged_return_5
within-session centred percentile rank of sigma20
estimand.inference: OLS intercept on daily coefficients with Newey-West HAC lag 5

specifications.name: published_baseline_full_sample
specifications.sample: all complete development rows for the published base regressors

specifications.name: baseline_price_complete_sample
specifications.sample: rows complete for the base regressors, outcome, and all three price controls
specifications.role: same-sample benchmark for the primary comparison

families_and_gate.primary_family: one two-sided development-period coefficient: beta_negative_share in full_price_path_controls
families_and_gate.multiplicity: none beyond the single primary test; nested rows are descriptive diagnostics
families_and_gate.survives_reversal_confound_if: The full-control coefficient is negative and its two-sided HAC p-value is below 0.05.
families_and_gate.same_sample_requirement: Interpret coefficient attenuation against baseline_price_complete_sample, not only against the larger published baseline sample.
families_and_gate.failure_interpretation: A negative coefficient whose interval includes zero preserves direction but does not rule out the price-path confound; a sign reversal or material collapse weakens the headline claim. No threshold, sample, transform, lag, or volatility window may be retuned after seeing the result.

required_outputs: same-sample baseline and primary full-control coefficient with HAC interval
daily coefficient files and exclusion audit
aggregate coefficient-path figure and dissertation-safe table
claim_boundaries: This test was motivated after the original development result was opened and is not independent confirmation.

Passing supports the bounded statement that negative-story share adds development-sample information beyond mean sentiment, story count, and these three observed price-path controls; it does not prove causality or eliminate every omitted variable.
Failure must be reported and cannot be repaired by retuning price lags, volatility windows, samples, horizons, or signs.
The FNSPID 2020-2023 evaluation outcome remains sealed in Notebook 75.
